results.title: Wenn das Licht gefriert
results.overview: Elisabeth has been married to Friedrich for 40 years and they’ve been happy, despite a few setbacks. Not even his Alzheimer’s disease can shake their love. Until one evening, during a TV show about the unsolved murder of their daughter’s best friend—which has remained a mystery for 22 years—Friedrich suddenly mentions details he shouldn’t possibly know.

results.title: Der Geier – Blut und Zweifel
results.overview: A seasonal worker is found murdered with a crossbow in the mountains of Bad Gastein. For former witness protection agent Lukas Geier, the case brings back a dark past. Racing against Detective Franziska Conte, he must uncover whether his former client is being framed or if he saved the wrong man.

results.title: Ungelesen
results.overview: Emmi Richter is 18 and doesn't know which path to take. After graduating from high school, her parents expect her to study law and choose a safe path. But Emmi's heart belongs to the arts: she writes, takes photographs, and paints. Caught between her dreams, fears about the future, and pressure from her parents, she must decide whether to meet their expectations or find the courage to forge her own path.

results.title: Ungehor§am
results.overview: The documentary follows activists who are fighting for a more just future through civil disobedience, accepting personal risks and legal consequences in the process. The film tells their David-versus-Goliath stories and places today’s protests for climate protection and human rights within the history of nonviolent resistance.

results.title: We entered as blacks, and we left as afrodescendants
results.overview: The memory of an Afro-Chilean family is permeated by the memory of Rosa Corvacho (1921-2011), their grandmother and matriarch, awakening in them a process of regression, where the bodies, voices and family gestures reactivate the denied history of Black Chile, such as Chileanization, the whitening policies of the north of the country and how these families lived in the daily life of the 20th century.

results.overview: A Halloween special for All Saints Street. The supernatural roommates of Room 1031 find their daily lives of rent, chores, and bickering interrupted by a mysterious old castle that sends out a summons. Facing an unexpected challenge of "life and death," the demons, vampires, werewolves, and angels must try to maintain their neighborly spirit and stick together through the spooky adventure.
